function.name: validate_fields
function.description: Check one or more patient fields as soon as the caller provides them (at minimum: after date of birth, and after the full address). Returns normalized values for valid fields and a plain-language problem for invalid ones. Does not save anything.

first_name.description: Patient's first name, spelled as confirmed by the caller.

last_name.description: Patient's last name, spelled as confirmed by the caller.

sex.description: Exactly one of: Male, Female, Other, Decline to Answer.

phone_number.description: 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only, e.g. 5125550143.

email.description: Optional. Email address in lowercase, e.g. jane.doe@gmail.com.

address_line_2.description: Optional. Apartment, suite or unit, e.g. Apt 3B.

insurance_provider.description: Optional. Name of the insurance company.

preferred_language.description: Optional. Preferred language, e.g. English or Spanish.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional. Emergency contact's 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only.

function.name: lookup_patient_by_phone
function.description: Check whether a patient record already exists for a phone number. Call immediately after collecting the caller's phone number.

phone_number.description: 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only, e.g. 5125550143.

function.name: register_patient
function.description: Save a NEW patient record. Only call after reading all information back to the caller and receiving explicit confirmation that it is correct. Include every field collected; omit optional fields not provided.

first_name.description: Patient's first name, spelled as confirmed by the caller.

last_name.description: Patient's last name, spelled as confirmed by the caller.

sex.description: Exactly one of: Male, Female, Other, Decline to Answer.

phone_number.description: 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only, e.g. 5125550143.

email.description: Optional. Email address in lowercase, e.g. jane.doe@gmail.com.

address_line_2.description: Optional. Apartment, suite or unit, e.g. Apt 3B.

insurance_provider.description: Optional. Name of the insurance company.

preferred_language.description: Optional. Preferred language, e.g. English or Spanish.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional. Emergency contact's 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only.

messages.content: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble saving that on our end. Would you like me to try again?

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update an EXISTING patient's record (found via lookup_patient_by_phone) after the caller confirms the changes. Send patient_id and only the fields that changed.

first_name.description: Patient's first name, spelled as confirmed by the caller.

last_name.description: Patient's last name, spelled as confirmed by the caller.

sex.description: Exactly one of: Male, Female, Other, Decline to Answer.

phone_number.description: 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only, e.g. 5125550143.

email.description: Optional. Email address in lowercase, e.g. jane.doe@gmail.com.

address_line_2.description: Optional. Apartment, suite or unit, e.g. Apt 3B.

insurance_provider.description: Optional. Name of the insurance company.

preferred_language.description: Optional. Preferred language, e.g. English or Spanish.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional. Emergency contact's 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only.

messages.content: I'm sorry, I couldn't save that update just now. Would you like me to try again?

function.name: get_available_appointments
function.description: Get up to three open first-visit appointment times. Only after the patient has been saved.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book the appointment slot the caller chose.

patient_id.description: patient_id returned by register_patient or lookup_patient_by_phone.

reason.description: Optional short reason for the visit, e.g. 'new patient checkup'.
